reasoning.step1:
Classification:
- Document contains "RECHNUNG" and invoice-like headers (Belegnummer, Datum, Pos., Netto, MwSt., Rechnungsendbetrag). No exclusion terms ("Zahlungserinnerung"/"Mahnung"/"Servicebericht") dominate. Therefore treat as invoice.

Fields to extract and evidence:
- Invoice.Date: "Datum: 24.11.2023" on page 1 and page 2 — extract "24.11.2023".
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Rechnungsendbetrag 3.445,20 EUR" on page 2 — numeric value 3445.20 (preserve decimals).
- Vat.Rate: VAT line shows "MwSt. 20 % 574,20 EUR" and line items list "20 %" — extract 20 (no % sign).
- Net.Amount: Net total line shows "Netto 2.871,00 EUR" — numeric value 2871.00.
- Vat.Amount: VAT amount shown "574,20 EUR" — numeric value 574.20.
- Sender.VatId: Two VAT IDs present: "Kd.UID-Nr.: ATU64131246" (customer) and at bottom "UID-NR: ATU17569806" next to company/bank info. Sender is SADLER-LICHTKUPPELN KUNSTSTOFFVERARBEITUNG GMBH (invoice issuer), so use "ATU17569806".

Alternatives considered and validation:
- Confirmed which UID corresponds to sender vs. customer by context: "Kd.UID-Nr." labels customer VAT; "UID-NR:" near company contact/bank corresponds to sender. Chose sender UID accordingly.
- Checked for multiple VAT rates or exchange rates: only 20% applies invoice-wide; no exchange rates for entire invoice found.
- Ensured numbers keep input decimals and converted comma decimal separators to dot for numeric fields.

Missing-data decisions:
- No ambiguity for the listed fields; all required schema fields present in document. No values inferred beyond explicit text.
reasoning.step2:
Invoice.Date — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: Explicit "Datum: 24.11.2023" appears clearly on both pages.
- Risk: OCR misread unlikely; same date repeated.

GrandTotal.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: "Rechnungsendbetrag 3.445,20 EUR" explicitly present.
- Risk: Could be total including/after discounts; context shows final invoice total.

- Risk: No other VAT rates shown.

Net.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: Summary line "Netto 2.871,00 EUR" matches sum of net line-item subtotals shown.
- Risk: OCR numeric grouping consistent.

Vat.Amount — Confidence: High (≈95%)
- Evidence: Summary "MwSt. 20 % 574,20 EUR" explicitly present.
- Risk: None apparent.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Medium-High (≈85%)
- Evidence: Two VAT identifiers present: "Kd.UID-Nr.: ATU64131246" (customer) and "UID-NR: ATU17569806" near company/bank block. Context indicates latter is issuer.
- Risk: Possible OCR placement ambiguity; label "UID-NR:" adjacent to company info but could conceivably refer to another entity.
